payload.title: Pretext main branch SSR bundle lacks amplify_outputs.json (front page 500)
payload.description: Root cause: the cms-production build spec wrote amplify_outputs.json only at the checkout root; the SSR compute bundle lacks it, so getLatestPublishedEdition threw. Fixed in Papyrus#156 (merge f0c0ee3, release 1.0.0-next.22): Pretext production spec copies it to .next/ and sets PAPYRUS_AMPLIFY_OUTPUTS. TI PR AnthusAI/Threat-Intelligence#12 picks it up.
